title: Venezuela cooperating on US-seized oil tankers, says Marco Rubio
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth have addressed journalists following the US army's seizure of two Venezuela-linked tanker and Donald Trump's reiterated remarks that the United States should take over Greenland, a territory that is part of the kingdom of Denmark. FRANCE 24's Philip Turle analyses their comments.
